Crime & Law · India

Two Air India planes on same Mumbai runway; takeoff aborted

An Air India flight aborted its takeoff at Mumbai airport after two aircraft, an Air India and an Air India Express plane, came face-to-face on the same runway. The incident, which occurred on a runway, was averted without any casualties. Air India has initiated an inquiry into the matter.
